note: T12 architecture as data. Layers, services, schema, port, metrics, deploy. Wire enumerations stay in the pack sections that already own them; this file holds pointers and flags.

llm_worker_concurrency.why: Our worker count, not a guessed provider quota. Overflow already carries COMPANION_QUEUE_FULL; raising this without a measured bill is a silent second queue

attest_lag_alert_ticks.why: Alert after two sealed ticks without a root so fail-open stays visible as SERVICE_DEGRADED before a city day of unattested records sits in the outbox

price_day_published.why: The raw sample row is a public object; a header TWAP without a CID is an unverifiable declaration, not a price

property_runs.why: fast-check runs per property test. Authored once so vitest and the oracle do not pick two different budgets

client_bundle_max_bytes.why: Ceiling for apps/client dist-web JS. Animation and shaders stay closed until a measured bundle sits under this cap

engine.why: Pure tick. A dependency here would drag HTTP or RPC into the public verifier

protocol.why: Generated literals only. Depending on engine would invert the wire and the function

contentpack.why: Loads a pack by hash and serves sections. Protocol types only

chainport.why: AssetPort interface. Engine stays free of RPC so a verifier never imports a provider

render.why: Visual v3 Three.js island; Pixi V12 is archive. Does not see engine, chainport, DB or services. Does not write state or call tick

api.why: Sole writer of player money tables. Host of commands and the state snapshot

sampler.why: Writes price samples into tick inputs. Must not depend on another service

buyback.why: Buyback transport. Tranche numbers live in launch.json, not here

attestor.why: Outbox and lag. Must not call into api; shared state lives in packages

llm.why: Advisor and daily summary live outside the tick. No engine import on this host

client.why: Browser. Engine import is preview_only. contentpack loads pack bytes bigint-safe; render draws the island and does not write state

api.why: Command host. Degraded sampler or attestor must not stop a payout

sampler.why: Silence writes feed_live=0. The tick uses the last stored sample and a code

buyback.why: Two legs, one host: fund mint after vault deposit; month basket hop fail-open. Does not debit a player

attestor.why: IPFS or RPC failure leaves payout in state and records in the outbox

llm.why: Provider refusal becomes a template. The economic tick does not wait

pack_gate.why: The only closed contour: unknown pack_hash must not price a shift

codes.why: Transport and domain codes are generated from the pack, never retyped

screens.why: Capabilities and commit effects come from screens.json

modifier_keys.why: Key ids on the wire match the T5 table

districts.why: District ids are pack entities, not a second client enum

buildings.why: Building ids follow the contour generator

units.why: The unit enum is the schema, not a handwritten TypeScript union

versions.why: rules_version and pack_version come from meta, not a client constant

schema_ddl.why: DDL is generated from the pack. A hand-written migration would be a second schema

command_routes.why: REST paths equal commit effects. A handwritten router would fork the bijection

layer_cruiser.why: Layer graph is data. Cruiser config is generated so a second inventory cannot exist

ws_channels.why: WS channels partition state_sources. Client must not author a second map

tsconfig_refs.why: Project references equal the layer table. A handwritten list would be a second graph

listen.why: Bind and ports are pack keys. A handwritten listen constant would be a second number

dockerfile.why: Runtime image pins pack_hash and must not ship Python or the content tree

compose.why: Compose lists entrypoint services and Postgres from the pack. A handwritten yaml would be a second port table

compose_prod.why: Prod profile is a built image with no source mount. A handwritten overlay would bring back volumes

env_example.why: Names without values. A value here would be a key in git

restore_sh.why: Restore command is pack data. A second script would fork the witness

ci_runner.why: Commit gate is the push track. Full attack.py lives on nightly, not this runner

ci_workflow.why: Workflow is one-way from the step table. A hand patch would put the full attack on push

env_manifests.why: dev staging prod manifests are pack data. A handwritten deploy list would fork the pin

foundry_toml.why: solc pin lives once in toolchain; a handwritten foundry.toml would fork the compiler

accounts.why: Demo versus wallet lives on the account row so a join cannot invent a transfer

cities.why: Clock anchor and city level sit with the owning account_kind

records.why: Layout v1 bytes that went into the merkle leaf, plus their hash

price_samples.why: Global sample row. One object per city day, CID referenced from the aggregate

intents.why: Idempotent command results. A lost withdraw must not run twice

fragments_ledger.why: Ledger, not a recompute on read. Demo isolation is account_kind

seasons.why: Influence integral storage. Prize payout stays v1.1

port.why: Exactly two implementations. RPC library import is illegal outside rpc

signer.why: Hot refund signer; guardian proposes rotation, this key accepts; not the buyback bot

secrets.why: One env name per key role. Values stay out of the repo and out of the image layer

voucher_signer.why: Bank voucher key. Named once; compose injects it, Dockerfile does not

buyback_executor.why: Buyback sender. A second name in yaml would split the role

prize_payer.why: Settled prize payer. Not the buyback executor

signer.why: Hot refund signer. Not listed in the Dockerfile

backup.why: A dump without a replay witness is not a restore. Period is a city day; retention follows the farm window divisor, not a stored cron

rehearsal.why: Rehearsal uses the prod pack; a second pack with a shorter city day is a different economy

i5_reserve_drain.why: Virgin drip cannot exceed the weekly drain cap even if cork inflates the stock

i7_exit_cover.why: Vault cover versus exit queue. Uncovered bps is a state code, not a raise

tick_determinism.why: No network, clock, or unseeded random on the tick path. Lag of a host is not an input

catchup_eq_replay.why: N ticks in one catch-up equal N online ticks. A second clock would desync the verifier

layout_v1_bytes.why: Canonical bytes of a record do not depend on key order. JSON columns would drift the root

demo_barrier.why: No demo to wallet path. Capital is not minted for demo and progress does not move

ops.why: One ops log is the addressee of every metric alert and every incident. Splitting channels splits the page the on-call reads

stale_sample.why: Age alert fires before staleness decays the mint rate. A silent green lamp here is R-P-5

attest_lag.why: Attestor fail-open; lag grows and SERVICE_DEGRADED is visible before a city day of unattested records

ipfs_pin_fail.why: Pin failure grows the outbox. Pay continues. The tick does not block

uncovered_claim.why: Leaderboard shows empty pool or uncovered claim. Not an owner-withdraw notice

signer_compromise.why: Guardian pauses. refundPlayer only up to backingOf. Nothing beyond. No forever-lock copy

node.why: Node LTS on the C0 machine. engines is the range copied into every manifest

pnpm.why: Workspace installer. packageManager in every manifest equals this pin

python.why: Pack oracle and attack.py run on CPython. The workflow pin must match the gate machine

typescript.why: typescript-eslint peers TypeScript below 6.1; 5.9.3 is the last 5.x line

vitest.why: Pin lives in the pack so a developer machine and the CI image cannot silently diverge for the workspace test runner

fast_check.why: Property tests for tick determinism. Run count is arch.params.property_runs

dependency_cruiser.why: Layer graph is data. Cruiser config is generated, this pin runs it

eslint.why: Flat config. Paired with eslint_js at the same 9.39.5 so the plugin set cannot split

eslint_js.why: Must match eslint. A split here is a silent second lint stack

typescript_eslint.why: Typed lint for engine bans. Peer range forbids TypeScript 7, which is why typescript stays 5.9.3

vite.why: Client bundler pin. Unused in C0 stubs, still authored so C5 cannot pick another

pixijs.why: PixiJS v8 stays the V12 archive renderer. Version is pack data; it is not the v3 frame

threejs.why: Three.js is the v3 island engine in packages/render. Pin matches package.json so the frame cannot drift

react.why: HUD is React. Pin matches react_dom so the pair cannot drift

react_dom.why: Must equal react. A second React on the client would be a second renderer

types_react.why: React 19.2.8 npm tarball has no types; the pin matches react so HUD types cannot drift

types_react_dom.why: Latest 19.2 types for react-dom 19.2.8. A second React types package would fork JSX

pg.why: Postgres driver for openPg. No ORM. Pin so L4 does not pull a second client

postgres.why: Server image major. Not an npm package; L267 ignores it in manifests

embedded_postgres.why: Starts a real Postgres for the L4 replay gate when Docker is absent. Runtime image does not ship it

prettier.why: Format is not discussed. One pin so CI and the editor rewrite the same bytes

types_node.why: Types follow Node 24. A 26-line of types on a 24 runtime would lie about APIs

corporator_protocol.why: Workspace protocol literals. Contentpack is the C2 consumer; the pin is the workspace, not a published tarball, so L267 can allow the layer-legal import

corporator_engine.why: Workspace tick. Api is the C3 consumer; the pin is the workspace so L267 allows the layer-legal import

corporator_contentpack.why: Workspace pack loader. Api serves GET /pack by hash; the pin is the workspace, not a published tarball

corporator_chainport.why: AssetPort mock and rpc. Buyback talks to vault; attestor submits the merkle root; sampler reads wallet price

corporator_render.why: Workspace island renderer. Client is the V3 consumer; the pin is the workspace so L267 allows the layer-legal import

electric_sql_pglite.why: In-process Postgres for the C3 gate and local host. Production replay is openPg; this pin stays a test driver

foundry.why: Forge runs the four contract groups locally. Hardhat would pull an ethers stack into the workspace before L8

solc.why: Single compiler pin for foundry.toml and pragma. A caret range would let two machines compile different bytecode

noble_secp256k1.why: Pure secp256k1 recover for session signatures. No network and no viem; the client never imports this pin

empty_tick.why: Tick with no agents: empty record list, header is still merkle leaf zero

payroll_trim.why: Fund trim publishes payroll_ratio_bps and keeps every positive request nonzero

day_boundary.why: Hour zero freezes budget, steps EMA and ratchet, does not rerun hour-six events

feed_dead.why: feed_live zero writes STALE_PRICE, decays down only, a zero sample mints zero

stack_nonempty.why: Non-empty modifier stack records stage_bps base and post, not a silent identity

cyrillic.why: Cyrillic in strings uses ensure_ascii false so keccak sees the same UTF-8 as Python

over_2_53.why: Integer above 2 to the 53 must survive canonical print without becoming a float

layout_v1_edge.why: Empty reason, empty building, zero fragment delta: layout v1 still encodes

keccak_l202.why: Pinned keccak vectors empty, abc, and three block-boundary lengths

merkle_shapes.why: One leaf equals root, odd level is not duplicated, leaves sort by agent_id UTF-8

cid_city_day.why: City-day CID of canonical city_id, city_day, root; codes from attest.params.cid_*

pack_lint.red_input: drop vault_fee_bps.why so L01 refuses the file
pack_lint.why: Pack gate stays on every commit. A silent schema break must not reach the image

pack_build.red_input: corrupt DESIGN.md 5.8 fixture so L05 fails the build
pack_build.why: The step track rebuilds the pack. A silent formula drift must not wait for night

codegen_check.why: Generated bytes are one-way. A hand patch would fork the wire from the pack

vector_oracle.catches: python oracle drift, missing vector class
vector_oracle.why: TS parity is against oracle bytes. A stale vector file must fail before merge

install_frozen.red_input: change pnpm-lock.yaml without a matching package.json
install_frozen.why: Toolchain pins live in the pack. An unlocked install would silently pick another tarball

workspace_gate.catches: tsc, eslint, depcruise, vitest construction names
workspace_gate.red_input: add an it() name missing from construction_tests
workspace_gate.why: Typecheck and the 1:1 vitest map close the stage. Nested pnpm ci is forbidden here

attack_full.catches: a lint rule that never fires, construction that never fails
attack_full.red_input: add attack.py --jobs 8 to a push track cmd
attack_full.why: Full attack lives only at night. On a step it costs an hour and the discipline dies

sim.catches: window A drift, return bands, bank measure
sim.red_input: put content/sim.py on a push track cmd
sim.why: Season simulation is the nightly envelope check. A step must not wait on it

forge_test.catches: solc pin drift, vault invariant, pause path
forge_test.red_input: drop forge_test from the nightly track
forge_test.why: Contract tests run at night. Push does not compile Solidity

image_smoke.catches: image without PACK_HASH, root user, python in runtime
image_smoke.why: Smoke the generated image. Prod has no source mount after P4

image.why: Runtime ships Node and a baked pack.json. Python, the content/ tree, and pglite stay off the image

audit.why: Every finding has a status in the pack. Markdown is the human copy; L321 reads this table

prize_deposit_requested_amount.why: PrizeTreasury.deposit credited the requested amount; a fee-on-transfer stock would inflate unsliced and slice more than arrived

stake_credits_requested_amount.why: StakeRegistry.stake credited the requested amount; a fee-on-transfer stock would overstate the snapshot the tick reads

vault_deposit_requested_amount.why: Vault.deposit credited the requested $CORP; pending and backing follow the measured balance delta

bare_erc20_transfer.why: Every ERC-20 transfer and transferFrom in callers sits inside require; a bare call would ignore a false return

stock_decimals_eighteen.why: PrizeTreasury and StakeRegistry do not assume decimals equals 18; atoms are credited as received

deployed_blocks_open_critical.why: An open critical finding cannot coexist with a nonempty launch.deployed row; the table is the lock

constructor_unpause_delay.why: unpauseDelay must be greater than zero; the owner seconds are not invented here and stay PENDING until P7

constructor_guardian_signer.why: Guardian and signer addresses are constructor args from env at PlayerReady; they are not invented in the pack

no_reentrancy_guard.why: Deposit pulls then credits; prize stocks are ERC-20 without hooks. A guard would be a new pattern, not a listed fix

usdt_void_return.why: Callers require a bool return; Robinhood stock tokens return bool. A low-level call to an arbitrary token is forbidden

outbound_token_fee.why: Outbound claim and returnUnsettled send the owed or unsliced amount and check the return; a token tax on send is the issuer, not a second kettle

external_audit_vendor.why: External vendor and budget stay owner; P4 may run while that calendar waits. No open critical on the five contracts

tx_origin_delegatecall_absent.why: src has no tx.origin, delegatecall, or proxy. A repair must not add them. L297 already fails those strings
